deposit_profile: A deposit address is one customer's: everything it sends goes to the wallets of one exchange (a sweep into a hot wallet), few outside addresses ever pay it, it never swaps on a DEX, and it is no token, pool, router or smart account.
hint: Answer: write every address in full (0x plus 40 characters), also when it repeats one named earlier and also when the user asks for shorter ones (name them instead); a transfer moves tokens, so write "tokens worth about N USD", never "sent N USD" or a $ figure; never draw the flows in text, ASCII or Mermaid, the host draws them. Say: "0xc0e17ad342afabd36b3971f8305ff147006962ae is a hot wallet of Bybit on robinhood, not a deposit address." A trail that reaches it has entered the exchange: end the trail there. Asked how a deposit address behaves, what makes an address one or what rules one out, answer with deposit_profile.
